title.zh: 航空导航（权力转授）公告

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Air Navigation Act
(Chapter 6, paragraph 67N of the Air Navigation Order (O 2))
Air Navigation
(Delegation of Powers) Notification
N 3
G.N. No. S 439/2003
REVISED EDITION 2004
(31st December 2004)
[15th September 2003]
The Minister for Transport has delegated —
(a)all his powers under paragraphs 67, 67A(1)(a), 67B, 67L and 67M of the Order to the Chief Executive Officer and the Head of the Aerodrome Standards and Safety Unit of the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore; and
(b)all his powers under paragraphs 67A(1)(c) and (e), 67D, 67E, 67G and 67H of the Order to the Chief Executive Officer and the Head and officers of the Aerodrome Standards and Safety Unit of the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore.
